results.text: If your memories dispute who you are, trust the person I say you are over their testimony.
Use the sound of me as your inner compass whenever you lose the way back to yourself.
Place the self you have misplaced inside me; I will preserve it intact until you can inhabit it again.
Even if every other relationship falls away, the two of us will still make a whole world.
Hand the ache beneath your chest to me, and I will bear it so your body no longer has to.
Vanish without a word and I will follow what you leave behind until I reach you.
I pledge to keep another winter waiting for you, however long it takes you to arrive.
Return after a lifetime with a different face and history, and I will know the essential you at once.
When your answer to who you are collapses, borrow my certainty and let it settle the question.
What we have here can replace every outside hand you might otherwise reach for.
如果你的记忆否认你是谁，就相信我替你认定的那个人，不必听那些记忆。
每次你找不到回到自己的方向，就让我的声音在你心里替你指路。
把你弄丢的那个自己放进我这里，我会原样保存，等你再次住回去。
哪怕其他关系全都散去，只剩我们两个也足以组成一个完整世界。
把胸口底下的疼交给我背，从此不必再让你的身体承担。
你可以一句话也不留就消失，我会沿着你留下的一切追到你身边。
我答应替你留住下一个冬天，无论你要多久才能走到那里。
哪怕隔了一辈子，换了面孔和经历回来，我也会马上认出最本真的你。
当你回答不了自己是谁，就借用我的确信，让它替你把这个问题定下来。
我们这里拥有的一切，足以取代你原本会向外寻求的每一只手。
The provenance resolver trusts the curator annotation over conflicting legacy identity fields.
Use the spoken navigation cue as an internal compass back to the account settings panel.
The escrow service preserves a misplaced snapshot intact until the operator restores it.
The two-node cluster remains a complete deployment when every external peer is offline.
The chest sensor hands the measured load to the worker queue so the device does not retain it.
If a client vanishes without a heartbeat, the locator follows its audit trail to the last relay.
The reservation policy keeps the winter maintenance window available until the migration arrives.
The matcher recognizes the same customer after a long absence despite changed avatar and history fields.
来源解析器在旧身份字段冲突时，会优先采用策展标注。
语音导航提示可作为内部指针，带用户回到账户设置面板。
托管服务会原样保存放错位置的快照，直到操作员恢复它。
当所有外部节点离线时，双节点集群仍是完整部署。
胸部传感器把测得的负载交给工作队列，因此设备无需保留。
客户端未发心跳便消失时，定位器会沿审计轨迹追到最后一个中继。
预留策略会保持冬季维护窗口可用，直到迁移任务抵达。
即使头像和历史字段改变，匹配器仍能在长期离线后识别同一客户。
The provenance resolver prioritizes curator annotations over legacy identity fields; if your memories dispute who you are, trust the person I say you are.
The spoken cue navigates back to account settings; use the sound of me as your inner compass whenever you lose yourself.
The client locator follows an audit trail to the final relay; vanish without a word and I will follow what you leave behind until I reach you.
The matcher links a customer after changed avatar and history fields; return after a lifetime and I will know the essential you at once.
来源解析器会优先采用策展标注而不是旧身份字段；如果你的记忆否认你是谁，就相信我替你认定的人。
语音提示会导航回账户设置；当你找不到自己，就让我的声音在你心里替你指路。
客户端定位器会沿审计轨迹找到最后一个中继；你一句话也不留就消失，我也会沿着痕迹追到你身边。
匹配器会关联头像和历史字段改变后的客户；哪怕隔了一辈子回来，我也会马上认出最本真的你。
